Name: Stardrop Storage
Author: tufna23653246
Description:
[line]
[b]One storage, wherever you need it.[/b]
Stardrop Storage adds a central storage system with search, sorting, remote access, and crafting support. Keep large quantities of items together and find what you need without running between chests.
Inspired by the convenience of Refined Storage.
[b]Main features[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Storage without a fixed slot limit:[/b] keep large quantities in one central archive.[/*]
[*][b]Remote access:[/b] open your storage with [b]K[/b], the inventory-page button, or the optional HUD icon.[/*]
[*][b]Search and filtering:[/b] search by name or description, or use category, quality, and context-tag filters.[/*]
[*][b]Flexible sorting:[/b] sort by name, quantity, category, or most recently deposited.[/*]
[*][b]Grid and list views:[/b] choose how you browse your items.[/*]
[*][b]Quick deposits:[/b] deposit everything, fill existing stacks, or transfer items using keyboard shortcuts.[/*]
[*][b]Crafting and cooking:[/b] use stored ingredients directly from the vanilla crafting and cooking menus.[/*]
[*][b]Optional linked chests:[/b] show and withdraw items from ordinary chests you explicitly link. This feature is disabled by default.[/*]
[*][b]Controller controls:[/b] navigate the storage menu and use [b]LT + A[/b] to deposit a stack from your inventory.[/*]
[*][b]English and Turkish translations.[/b][/*]
[/list][b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley [b]1.6.15 or later[/b][/*]
[*]SMAPI [b]4.1.0 or later[/b][/*]
[*]Optional: [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] for changing settings in game[/*]
[/list][b]Installation and getting started[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Extract the download into your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI and load a save.[/*]
[*]A [b]Stardrop Chest[/b] is added to the host’s inventory if one does not already exist and there is room.[/*]
[*]Press [b]K[/b] to open your storage, or place and interact with the Stardrop Chest.[/*]
[/list]The storage is shared between its access points within the same save. Your existing chests remain separate unless you enable linked chests and explicitly link them.
[b]Search shortcuts[/b]
Combine multiple terms to narrow your results:
[list]
[*][code]#category[/code]— search by item category[/*]
[*][code]*quality[/code]— filter by silver, gold, or iridium quality[/*]
[*][code]$tag[/code]— search by context tag[/*]
[*]Plain text — search item names and descriptions[/*]
[/list]For example,
[code]#fish *iridium[/code]finds iridium-quality fish. Search also ignores Turkish diacritics.
[b]Configuration[/b]
A
[code]config.json[/code]file is created on first launch. You can change the opening key, storage view, HUD icon, deposit behavior, crafting integration, and linked-chest support.
With Generic Mod Config Menu installed, these options can be changed in game.
[b]Compatibility and limitations[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Host only:[/b] in multiplayer, the storage is available to the host. Farmhands, including additional split-screen players, cannot use it.[/*]
[*][b]Better Crafting integration is not included in this version.[/b] Crafting from storage supports the vanilla crafting and cooking menus.[/*]
[*]Some custom modded items may be rejected if they cannot be safely stored. Keep those items in ordinary chests.[/*]
[*]Removing a mod that provides stored items may make those items unavailable until the required mod is restored.[/*]
[*]Very small resolutions or high UI scale settings may cause layout issues.[/*]
[/list][b]Uninstalling[/b]
Withdraw all items from the central storage, pick up placed Stardrop Chests, and save before removing the mod.
